channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Love it or hate it, St. Paul’s green Spruce Tree Centre is having a moment
item.description: The design of the distinctive green-tiled building, much-discussed on social media and even knitted into scarves, grew from one woman’s love of evergreens.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild fall in overtime to Predators in last home game before World Junior Tournament
item.description: Steven Stamkos scored on a redirect in overtime to beat the Wild, whose next game at Grand Casino Arena comes Jan. 10.

item.title: Minnesota legislators say laws on failure to report child abuse need fresh look
item.description: Convictions for violating the statute are scarce, and fines are often similar to traffic tickets. A Minnesota senator wants to strengthen the laws designed to protect children.

item.title: Takeaways: Julius Randle steps up in fourth quarter of Timberwolves’ victory over Knicks
item.description: The former New York star shot 7-for-9 in the fourth quarter and finished with 25 points against his old team.

item.title: What’s open, closed on Christmas Day in the Twin Cities area
item.description: Most grocery, liquor and other stores will be closed, parking meters are free, and buses will run on limited schedules, if at all.

item.title: Don’t call it a spa: 100-person sauna Bathhouse coming to Minneapolis’ North Loop
item.description: The facility will include a rooftop pool, massages, a steam room and more when it opens in 2027.

item.title: Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy out vs. the Lions with a hairline fracture in his right hand
item.description: Though McCarthy will miss the Christmas Day game, Vikings coach Kevin O’Connell said there’s a chance the quarterback could play against the Packers in the season finale.

item.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune sues Minneapolis for allegedly withholding public information
item.description: The news organization says the Minneapolis Police Department has failed to release information about crimes.

item.title: Despite community outrage, Brooklyn Center council fires city manager
item.description: Residents packed the council chambers, chanted and held up signs in support of City Manager Reggie Edwards.

item.title: Walz expects influx of ICE agents in Minnesota around holidays
item.description: The governor held a news conference with community and faith leaders in north Minneapolis, calling on residents to help observe immigration enforcement activity in the coming days.
